zh: 修复 macOS 提交详情和暂存区滚动时，已展开的差异内容跳动的问题。
macOS 和 Windows 在对应的工具栏按钮上显示切换分支、抓取、拉取和推送的进度。
en: Fix jumps when scrolling through expanded diffs in commit details and the staging area on macOS.
Show progress on the corresponding toolbar buttons when switching branches, fetching, pulling, or pushing on macOS and Windows.

zh: macOS 和 Windows 新增连续提交压缩，支持编辑合并后的提交信息，并在执行前检查远程状态、备份历史，支持中断恢复。
macOS 和 Windows 新增“禁用提交操作”设置，隐藏提交、合并及暂存等控件，保留更改浏览，拉取仅允许快进。
macOS 支持多选、双击和拖拽暂存或取消暂存，可按文件或更改块丢弃更改，未跟踪文件移入废纸篓。
macOS 新增会话内提交草稿、Amend 开关和提交信息预填，标题超过 72 个字符时提示，快捷输入支持排序和删除撤销。
macOS 新增提交拣选、Soft、Mixed、Hard 分支重置和远程分支跟踪检出，完善分支删除确认与标签检出交互。
macOS 贮藏支持填写说明、显示来源分支和创建时间，新增弹出操作，删除贮藏时需确认。
macOS 目录视角新增可缩放的图片预览，完善目录树键盘导航、文件打开和路径复制，支持快捷切换两种浏览视角。
macOS 侧栏可显示普通仓库的当前分支，支持失效仓库重新定位、撤销仓库移除及分组解散，批量移除时需确认。
macOS 优化历史多选、键盘翻页和预加载，修正差异方向并保留比较刷新状态，大型差异及生成文件默认折叠。
macOS 和 Windows 改善多行输入与提交信息换行；macOS 优化窄窗口布局、操作进度和失败重试，并减小安装包体积。
en: Add consecutive commit squashing on macOS and Windows with editable messages, remote publication checks, history backups and recovery after interruption.
Add a setting to disable commit operations on macOS and Windows, hiding commit, merge and staging controls while keeping changes browsable and allowing fast-forward pulls only.
Stage or unstage files on macOS through multi-selection, double-clicking or drag and drop. Discard files or hunks, moving untracked files to the Trash.
Add session commit drafts, an Amend toggle and message prefilling on macOS, warn when subjects exceed 72 characters, and support snippet reordering and undoing deletion.
Add cherry-picking, Soft, Mixed and Hard resets and local tracking checkout for remote branches on macOS, with improved branch deletion confirmations and tag checkout interactions.
Add stash messages, source branch and creation time details, Pop and deletion confirmations on macOS.
Add zoomable image previews in Directory View on macOS, improve tree keyboard navigation, file opening and path copying, and add shortcuts for switching browsing modes.
Show branch names for ordinary repositories in the macOS sidebar, relocate missing repositories, undo repository removal or group dissolution, and confirm batch removal.
Improve history multi-selection, keyboard paging and preloading on macOS, correct diff direction, preserve comparison state on refresh, and collapse large diffs and generated files by default.
Improve multiline input and commit message line breaks on macOS and Windows. Refine compact layouts, operation progress and failure retries on macOS, and reduce its installer size.

zh: macOS 新增应用内更新，支持下载安装并重启；旧版需先手动安装本版本，后续可直接在应用内升级。
macOS 更新说明跟随应用语言，中文界面显示中文，其余语言暂时显示英文。
en: Add in-app updates on macOS with download, installation and relaunch. Install this version manually once to enable future in-app updates.
Show macOS release notes in the app's language: Chinese for Chinese interfaces, and English for all other languages for now.

zh: macOS 和 Windows 支持右键复制主仓库与工作树的本地路径。
en: Copy the local path of a main repository or worktree from its context menu on macOS and Windows.

zh: macOS 新增目录视角，可浏览完整文件、使用语法高亮和文件内搜索，并从差异页跳转到对应文件。
macOS 侧栏实时显示工作树状态，支持批量清理已合并的工作树，并在删除忽略文件前确认。
macOS 在暂存或取消暂存后定位并高亮文件，提交信息区可按需隐藏。
macOS 可设置全局自动抓取间隔，也可为单个仓库单独设置。
macOS 和 Windows 支持以相对时间、完整日期或混合模式显示提交时间。
en: Add Directory View on macOS to browse full files with syntax highlighting and in-file search, and jump to the corresponding file from a diff.
Show live worktree status in the macOS sidebar and clean up merged worktrees in batches, with confirmation before deleting ignored files.
Scroll to and highlight files after staging or unstaging on macOS, and let users hide the commit message area.
Set a default auto-fetch interval on macOS and override it for individual repositories.
Choose relative times, exact dates and times, or a hybrid format for commit timestamps on macOS and Windows.

zh: macOS 新增 Git 命令日志，支持搜索、筛选、复制与导出。
macOS 改进操作失败提示，可查看关联命令日志及自动获取、工作树错误详情。
macOS 修复手动获取成功后自动获取警告未清除的问题。
en: Add Git command logs on macOS with search, filtering, copying and export.
Improve failure messages on macOS with access to related command logs and automatic fetch and worktree error details.
Fix stale automatic fetch warnings after a successful manual fetch on macOS.

zh: macOS 新增改动目录树，工作区与提交历史可独立展开目录和差异，并按整个目录暂存或取消暂存。
macOS 新增文件暂存与取消暂存动画，遵循系统减少动态效果设置，并优化文件操作按钮。
macOS 改进仓库分组与非活跃仓库的折叠操作，精简 macOS 与 Windows 的工具栏、搜索及操作文案。
macOS 新增启动时检查更新与菜单中的手动检查，发现新版本后可打开发布页下载。
en: Add change directory trees on macOS for the working copy and commit history, with independent folder and diff expansion and directory-wide staging and unstaging.
Add file staging and unstaging animations on macOS that respect Reduce Motion, and refine file action buttons.
Improve folding of repository groups and inactive repositories on macOS, and simplify toolbar, search and action labels on macOS and Windows.
Add update checks at launch and a manual menu command on macOS, with a link to download newer releases.

zh: 新增 macOS 原生菜单与快捷键，快速操作仓库、分支和提交。
加快 macOS 仓库切换与工作区改动加载，减少等待。
优化应用图标的液态玻璃折射、蓝色背景与网格对比度。
en: Add native macOS menus and shortcuts for repositories, branches and commits.
Improve repository switching and working change loading on macOS.
Refine the app icon with glass refraction, deeper blue and clearer grid lines.

zh: 首次发布，支持按目录或分组管理多个仓库与工作树。
支持提交历史、差异查看、暂存、提交及分支同步。
提供 macOS 原生应用与 Windows x64、ARM64 安装包。
en: First release with repositories and worktrees organized by folder or group.
Browse history and diffs, stage and commit changes, and sync branches.
Available as a native macOS app and Windows x64 and ARM64 installers.
